packageRules.description: babel-plugin-react-compiler 1.0.0 is built on @babel/types 7; under @babel/core 8 it skips every component with a defaulted destructured prop (#721). Lift when the compiler supports Babel 8.

Regenerate protobuf output when a code generator or its runtime moves. The generated tree embeds the plugin version (survey_pb.ts's @generated stamp), so a bump that does not regenerate fails make check-generated in the merge queue, where the full suite always runs. fileFilters keep the task from committing anything outside the generated trees. minimumReleaseAge is restated on this entry: the org preset already soaks for seven days, and a packageRules entry that omits the key is flagged even when the preset applies.

customManagers.description: buf.gen.yaml pins the Go code generators as `go run` of `<module>@<version>`, split across YAML list items. The org preset's regex only sees `go install` in Makefiles and workflows, so without this the pin buf actually executes is invisible and goes stale.
buf.gen.ui.yaml pins protoc-gen-es as `npx --package=@bufbuild/protoc-gen-es@<version>`. The npm manager sees ui/package.json and not this command, which is the one buf executes.
